title: Quality Repairs
description: Adds a few ways to repair your tools.
body:
![Quality Repairs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c60df98fa283ba5ae19c283480a8ed5354a70f1.png)
### What is Quality Repairs?

Quality Repairs is a simple mod that aims to add a few ways to keep your tools from breaking without the need of mending.

### The Whetstone
![Whetstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2565ac7f656a3a36b434f26d11aa323520222789.png)

The whetstone repairs tools based on **how much durability it has left**, repairing a tool more the closer it is to breaking. A whetstone can be **used 6 times before breaking**. (Also you can't repair a whetstone with another whetstone)

To **use a whetstone**, you can hold it in your offhand (or main hand) and your tool in your main hand (or offhand) and right click.
Alternatively, you can repair tools in your inventory by holding a whetstone with your cursor and right clicking on your tool (or vis versa).

### The Altar
![Altar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33679f25037dc499a773b4c41ef3d3025498849b.png)

The altar repairs tools using **xp**, priced based on how close the tool is to breaking. It exchanges 1.75 durability per point of xp, so its slight worse then mending.

### The Obelisk
![Obelisk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd3043205c16721da155fe55195788b62f4e36fc.png)

The Obelisk can repair tools over time **without** any additional costs required. **However**, using xp will repair your tool much faster. To provide the Obelisk with xp, you need to use an Idol to deposit xp. You can also withdraw the stored xp using an Idol as well. The Obelisk **cannot be crafted** but can be found on an altar within the Deep Dark.

### The Idol
![Idol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dde17f0e6bca2243dab073d1cef964b157b59f41.png)

The Idol can be used to **extract and store xp** from the player. Just hold right click and xp will slowly enter the Idol. To extract xp from a Idol, you need to use a powered dispenser to dispense the xp. 

In the future I plan to add the ability to change things using configs.
